patterns.reminder: Hardcoded credential. MENTORAI stores no credential in source. Read it from the environment or a secret manager and verify it server-side.
Telegram credential literal (bot token, api_hash or MTProto session string). These grant full access to the account or bot. Load from the secret manager, never commit, never log.
Authentication or role state in browser storage. A viewer can edit it. Enforce the check server-side and keep the session in an HttpOnly cookie.
SQL built by string interpolation. Telegram message text reaches these queries. Use parameterized queries.
PII or message content in a log at INFO or above. Log the internal student ID instead.
Secret assignment outside .env.example. Keep real values out of the repository entirely.
